connector.name: Gmail Attachments MCP
connector.registryDescription: Minimal MCP server for downloading Gmail attachments to disk. Read-only OAuth by default.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package gmail-attachments-mcp. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the zayansalman account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: GMAIL_MCP_CREDENTIALS
env.description: Path to the Google OAuth client secret JSON. Default: $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/gmail-attachments-mcp/credentials.json.

env.name: GMAIL_MCP_TOKEN
env.description: Path to the cached Gmail OAuth refresh token. Default: $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/gmail-attachments-mcp/token.json.

env.name: GMAIL_MCP_DEFAULT_DEST_DIR
env.description: Default directory where downloaded attachments are saved when the tool call does not specify dest_dir. Default: ~/Downloads.
